_comment: Merge the SessionStart entry below into your agent's settings.json (project-level .claude/settings.json or ~/.claude-<agent>/settings.json). Replace the path with wherever you put the script; forward slashes work on Windows and avoid JSON escaping mistakes. Runs on session start and after compaction: recognized stock/v1 copies are updated, current copies are unchanged, and unfamiliar copies return nonzero for inspection.
